name: abxglia-diff-bridge
description: Socket-based diff bridge for abxglia-grok: opens diffs with real file names in the correct Cursor window, auto-closes on permission resolve.

abxgliaDiffBridge.enabled.description: Enable the diff bridge (socket server + auto-close).

abxgliaDiffBridge.grokHome.description: GROK_HOME path (defaults to ~/.abxglia-grok). Set if you use a custom GROK_HOME.
